name: Dena Sharp
tagline: Top rated Civil Litigation attorney in San Francisco, California

about: Dena Sharp is an attorney who represents clients in the San Francisco, California area. Dena Sharp is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2017 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Dena Sharp chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended University of California College of the Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings) and graduated in 2006. Dena Sharp passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2006.
She represents clients with Civil Litigation: Plaintiff issues in California. She also represents clients with Class Action / Mass Torts: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Dena Sharp has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
